text: the multi select is not working yet. try that again. the spin works with select tho
resolution: Fixed multi-select: the mouse-press event in this framework does NOT carry modifier flags (shiftKey/ctrlKey were always falsy on the press, so shift/ctrl-click always replaced instead of grouping). Switched to the held-modifier ref from the key bus — useHeldModifiers() (the same source IsoAuthor uses; tracked via __keydown/__keyup). onDown now reads heldMods.current.shift/ctrl/meta as the add modifier, so shift OR ctrl-click toggles each element into the per-mode set and groups multiple. Spin+select and Esc-clear are unchanged. Bundle-clean, hot-reload, fps untouched.
